about: Documented outliers in the shipped Danish audio, each pinned to its measured value (scripts/validate-audio-acoustics.mjs). An exception holds only while the clip still measures what is recorded here; a drift in either direction fails the gate. Adding one needs a disposition, never a wider limit. `releaseBlocker` marks a launch-reachable clip that is wrong today; the gate prints it on every run.

rejse.mp3.disposition: Chirp3 lead the verified frame trim could not cut (2026-09-06). The onset map compensates: the player starts it 60 ms before the voice (clipStartAt), so the audible delay is the ordinary pre-roll. A cut needs its own verified trim, not a blind second pass (trim is not idempotent).

slow/knae.mp3.disposition: As rejse: untrimmed lead, compensated by the onset map.
